ADMIN_PUBKEY.description: Administrator's Nostr public key: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, not an npub. Never enter a private key; it stays in your NIP-07 signer.

MASTER_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Random secret key material of at least 32 bytes, used to encrypt stored private keys. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Changing it later prevents decrypting existing keys.

REMOTE_SIGNER_PRIVATE_KEY.description: A new, valid Nostr private key dedicated to the NIP-46 remote signer. Enter 64 hexadecimal characters or nsec; never reuse a key from another purpose.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
